Situation: As of 2026-10-21, pregabalin 300 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 675 capsules (43 days at 15.7/day). Corvale General holds 489 capsules (26.2 days at 18.6/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 89 capsules (18.7 days at 4.8/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include pregabalin as of 2026-10-21. A labeled product from Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) was last inspected on 2026-07-16 and classified VAI.

Our position: Current inventory covers 18.7 to 43 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Supply continuity depends on proactive purchasing before Lakeside stock falls below two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (ranked option 1); requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer places purchase order with Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC (ranked option 2); requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer places purchase order with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (ranked option 3); requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer places purchase order with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (ranked option 4); requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer places purchase order with Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC (ranked option 5); requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying orders until any site reaches critical stock levels.
